gen-gf-unkempt-gf-mooli: Expressive and sign-shop blunt, Unkempt looks like vinyl cut to a single line width. Mooli follows with open round letters that stay readable down at small sizes, so paragraphs go down easily.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-national-park: Unkempt makes its headline statement with a crossbar and stem of matching weight, loud and expressive. And National Park, written with an unchanging pen and rounded, open-sided forms, keeps text moving smoothly beneath it.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-noto-sans-canadian-abo: Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal keeps every curve end open, so text slips by without snagging. But Unkempt above it is loud, with the same line width in curves and straights.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-noto-sans-cypriot: Approachable and clean, Noto Sans Cypriot lets its e open up rather than close its eye. But Unkempt, with every curve matching its straight stems, leaves the body text to read easily beneath it.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-noto-sans-cypro-minoan: Blunt and loud: Unkempt gives stems and crossbars one thickness, while Noto Sans Cypro Minoan trims terminals to leave a gap. Text beneath it reads crisp and unhurried, line after line.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-noto-sans-javanese: Unkempt draws every letter in flat, unmodulated line weight. Noto Sans Javanese keeps its apertures open to the outside space, so the two meet as loud headline and quiet text.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-noto-sans-manichaean: Open-mouthed e crossbars keep the text readable, while Unkempt shouts above it with stroke ends as wide as the middle. Noto Sans Manichaean is the quiet half, and its restraint carries the pair.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-noto-sans-old-south-ar: Noto Sans Old South Arabian ends its curves before they turn inward, which makes text feel approachable. But Unkempt does the shouting with one flat line weight, leaving the quiet work to its partner.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-philosopher: Loud and unfussy: Unkempt has no hairlines to squint at, while Philosopher lets soft shifts in thickness give its curves daylight. Unkempt is built to announce; Philosopher is built to carry text.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-quattrocento-sans: Modern and clean, Quattrocento Sans keeps its c from looking like o, while Unkempt makes crossbars fat as the stems they connect. Paragraphs below it move along without any fuss.
